Officer's narrative
On arrival at the intersection in Houston, Texas, I found a rear-end collision between two vehicles. Driver 1 was
stopped in the right lane when the vehicle operated by Driver 2 struck the rear of Driver 1's car. The impact appeared
light, and both vehicles were drivable from the scene. The damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and the front of
Driver 2's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact. Witnesses, photographs taken at the scene, and Driver 2's
statement all describe the collision in the same manner. Passenger was in Driver 1's vehicle at the time, and both the
witnesses and I confirmed this. Driver 1 reported back strain and described the pain as severe, although the low-force
nature of the impact seems insufficient to account for that level of injury. A few older scratches on the rear bumper
may predate this collision, and I have not determined their origin. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy
covering the vehicle.
